title: Easton realization, GCH, and SCH
deferred_material: Easton's realization theorem for continuum functions on regular cardinals; consistency or independence results about GCH and SCH
supporting_development_needed: Use the existing [model-witness criteria](entries/larger-models/entry.html#independence-witnesses), then develop **Models of set theory: relativization and absoluteness** and **Forcing: partial orders, generic filters, and extensions**. A precise Easton statement must specify its model and cardinal-preservation framework; necessary inequalities alone are not a realization theorem.
